dmm-2016-tiebreaker-01.prompt: How many ordered triples of integers $(a,b,c)$ where $1\le a,b,c\le10$ are such that for every natural number $n$, the equation $(a+n)x^2+(b+2n)x+c+n=0$ has at least one real root?

dmm-2016-tiebreaker-02.prompt: Find the smallest integer $n$ such that we can cut an $n\times n$ grid into $5$ rectangles with distinct side lengths in $\{1,2,3,\dots,10\}$. Every value is used exactly once.
